sources.snippet: my_awesome_model is a fine-tuned version of DistilBERT-base-uncased, specifically optimized for text classification tasks. The model demonstrates impressive performance metrics, achieving a training accuracy of 92.95% and a final training loss of 0.0632 after 2 epochs of training.
